description: This file contains implementations of the Mat4 class methods, including constructors, static transformation matrix generators (rotation, translation, scaling, frustum, perspective, orthographic), matrix multiplication, vector multiplication, and a dump function for debugging.

classes.name: Mat4
classes.description: A 4x4 matrix class providing constructors, static methods for common transformations, matrix multiplication, vector transformation, and debugging output.

methods.name: Mat4()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing to identity matrix.

methods.name: Mat4(const Matrix<float> generalMatrix)
methods.description: Constructs a Mat4 from a general matrix, copying up to 4x4 elements.

methods.name: Mat4(const std::vector<float> &elements)
methods.description: Constructs a Mat4 from a vector of 16 floats.

methods.name: Mat4(const float *elements)
methods.description: Constructs a Mat4 from a pointer to 16 floats.

methods.name: Mat4(float m00, float m01, ..., float m33)
methods.description: Constructs a Mat4 with specified 16 float elements.

methods.name: Rotate(float angle, const Vector3 &axis)
methods.description: Creates a rotation matrix around a given axis by a specified angle in degrees.

methods.name: Translate(const Vector3 &t)
methods.description: Creates a translation matrix for a given vector.

methods.name: Scale(const Vector3 &s)
methods.description: Creates a scaling matrix for given scale factors.

methods.name: Frustum(float l, float r, float b, float t, float n, float f)
methods.description: Creates a frustum projection matrix with specified bounds.

methods.name: Perspective(float fov, float aspectRatio, float n, float f)
methods.description: Creates a perspective projection matrix based on field of view and aspect ratio.

methods.name: Ortho(float l, float r, float b, float t, float n, float f)
product(const Mat4 &m)
methods.description: Returns the product of this matrix with another Mat4.

methods.name: product(const Vector4 &b)
methods.description: Transforms a Vector4 by this matrix.

methods.name: dump()
methods.description: Prints the matrix elements for debugging.
